legacy_corruption.assessment: No PB-2/PB-3 contradiction observed for the new writer within trusted POSIX storage: retaining damaged historical evidence and requiring explicit repair is preferable to silently overwriting it. Physical power-loss behavior and actual legacy-store manual recovery remain unverified.
